releases.title: Public MVP
releases.goal: Hikma AI ships as a neutral open-source CLI: brew on macOS and Linux, an install script elsewhere, and skills from any repo.
releases.exit: A public repo with a tagged release installs via brew and the install script, installs and pushes skills against a real registry, and contains no bundled registry.

releases.title: Registry workflow
releases.goal: Make the registry workflow solid: restore from the lockfile, coexist with gh skill, and validate registries in CI.
releases.exit: hikma sync restores a repo from the lockfile, skills installed by gh skill are adopted cleanly, and a GitHub Action validates registry pull requests.

releases.title: Trust
releases.goal: Make installs verifiable, releases signed, and agents user-defined.
releases.exit: Custom agents in config, frozen installs and skill verification, and signed release artifacts are available.

releases.title: Personal scope
releases.goal: Support user-scope (global) installs with the same lockfile, verify, and safety gates as project installs.
releases.exit: hikma skill install --global works for every supported agent with its own lockfile, a confirmation gate, and duplicate warnings.

releases.title: Guided CLI
releases.goal: Make hikma easy to start and pleasant to read: guided completion setup, a menu and wizards over the flag commands, and a recognizable terminal look.
releases.exit: Bare hikma opens a menu in a terminal and prints help elsewhere, every wizard path prints its equivalent flag command, output is colored only on a terminal, and the logo ships in the CLI, site, and README.

releases.title: Stable
releases.goal: Stable contracts, hardened quality, and complete docs.
releases.exit: Config keys, the lockfile format, and the skill layout are documented and versioned; CI covers all supported platforms end to end.

releases.title: Parked
releases.goal: Ideas that gh skill already covers or that wait for demand.
